sentences.en: - President Wright, fellow honorees, deans, very distinguished members of the Board of Trustees and faculty, graduating students, parents and friends.
sentences.zh: - 赖特总统、名誉同事、院长、董事会和教师的杰出成员、毕业生、家长和朋友。

sentences.en: Yours is a great institution of higher learning, one of the finest in the country.
sentences.zh: 你是一个伟大的高等学府 国内最优秀的

sentences.en: And your generous decision to make me today one of your honorary graduates is an honor which I deeply appreciate.
sentences.zh: 你今天让我成为你荣誉毕业生的慷慨决定 是我的荣幸 我非常感激

sentences.en: And all of you who get your degrees today, congratulations.
sentences.zh: 你们今天都拿到学位了 恭喜

sentences.en: Together with you and like you, I know that commencement exercises are more than a ceremony.
sentences.zh: 与你和像你一样, 我知道,开始练习 不仅仅是一个仪式。

sentences.en: They transcend even the rite of passage inherent in their symbolism.
sentences.zh: 它们甚至超越了其象征意义所固有的通行仪式。

sentences.en: They represent the watershed in your life.
sentences.zh: 它们是你生活中的分水岭

sentences.en: From now on, there will be a before and then after.
sentences.zh: 从现在起,会有 前后。

sentences.en: You are about to enter the outside world.
sentences.zh: 你即将进入外面的世界。

sentences.en: Is anyone waiting for you there? And this is the moment you ask yourselves, where am I in my life?
sentences.zh: 有人在等你们吗?

sentences.en: What role has it prepared for me? What is the state of the world out there?
sentences.zh: 它为我准备了什么角色?

sentences.en: A story which may be useful to the medical graduates, the MDs already.
sentences.zh: 这个故事也许对医学毕业生, 即医学博士有用。

sentences.en: The story is a man came to his doctor with numerous complaints.
sentences.zh: 有个男人向医生提出无数投诉

sentences.en: The doctor examines him thoroughly, and at the end, naturally, asks him to open his mouth and said, "Oh friend, I don't like your tongue."
sentences.zh: 医生仔细检查他,最后自然地 要求他张开嘴说,“哦,朋友,我不喜欢你的舌头。”

sentences.en: And the patient answered, "That's the only one I have."
sentences.zh: 病人回答说, "这是我唯一的一个。"

sentences.en: Well, graduates, this is the only world we have.
sentences.zh: 毕业生们,这是我们唯一的世界

sentences.en: Who or what is there that will tell us what to do in order to preserve our humanity and celebrate that of others?
sentences.zh: 谁或有什么能告诉我们应该做些什么来保护我们的人性和庆祝其他人的人性?

sentences.en: A future husband or wife, a friend, perhaps a profitable position or situation.
sentences.zh: 未来的丈夫或妻子 朋友 也许是有利可图的职位或状况

sentences.en: Those who have invested in your education, their talent and knowledge have done so, believing that you will one day emerge in positions of power or influence,
sentences.zh: 那些投入于你的教育、他们的才能和知识的人,确已这样做了,他们确信你们将来必定成为有权力或有影响力的人,

sentences.en: whose decisions may affect the welfare and the lives of many or at least of one other person.
sentences.zh: 其决定可能影响许多人或至少其他人的福利和生活。

sentences.en: And that will be their reward. So whatever life will take you, whatever your endeavor might be in any field and whatever the social surroundings,
sentences.zh: 那是他们的报酬。无论你怎样生活,无论你在任何领域和任何社会环境中的努力,

sentences.en: it is what you have received here from your able and inspired teachers that will serve as your vantage points and guides.
sentences.zh: 这正是你们从你们的干练和有启发的教师那里得到的,他们将指导你们的工作。

sentences.en: Do not forget them. I have not forgotten mine.
sentences.zh: 别忘了,我没有忘记我的

sentences.en: Most belong to the distant past. Some were more recent.
sentences.zh: 大部分属于遥远的过去,有些是最近。

sentences.en: All remain in my memory. Isaiah and Rabbi Akiba, Plato and Spinoza, Dostoevsky and Kafka, their vision has retained its haunting quality
sentences.zh: 以赛亚和阿基巴拉比、柏拉图和斯宾诺萨、多斯托耶夫斯基和卡夫卡都留在我的记忆中。

sentences.en: and their voice, when I write or when I teach, reverberates in my own.
sentences.zh: 当我写作或教学时，他们的声音会在我自己的声音中回响。

sentences.en: The teacher in me tells you that what he has learned from them is what I can give you: the magic of words and the weight of silence that separates one from the other.
sentences.zh: 我心中的老师告诉你，他从他们身上学到的东西就是我可以给你的：语言的魔力和将彼此分开的沉默的重量。

sentences.en: But I've also learned from others who were their enemies and mine, sad lessons, dark lessons, appalling lessons.
sentences.zh: 但我也从他们的敌人和我的敌人那里学到了悲伤的教训、黑暗的教训、可怕的教训。

sentences.en: They have taught me that education can be frail and culture vulnerable when they are void of moral dimensions.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，如果缺乏道德维度，教育和文化就会变得脆弱。

sentences.en: Whether in the sciences or in the humanities, in the field of law or of religion, your pursuit of knowledge and truth has led you to distinguish between what helps humanity move forward
sentences.zh: 无论是在科学领域还是人文学科，在法律领域还是宗教领域，您对知识和真理的追求使您能够区分什么有助于人类前进

sentences.en: toward light and warmth, and what compels you to remain behind in frustration and darkness.
sentences.zh: 走向光明和温暖，以及是什么迫使你在挫折和黑暗中落后。

sentences.en: I have learned that racism is stupid. Not only is it ugly, it is stupid.
sentences.zh: 我了解到种族主义是愚蠢的。它不仅丑陋，而且愚蠢。

sentences.en: All forms of racism are stupid. As I have learned anti-Semitism was appalling, repulsive, grotesque.
sentences.zh: 所有形式的种族主义都是愚蠢的。据我所知，反犹太主义是令人震惊的、令人厌恶的、怪诞的。

sentences.en: I have witnessed the unspeakable fate of countless Jewish children, the first to be targeted by the enemy for annihilation.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼目睹了无数犹太儿童的难以言喻的命运，他们是第一个成为敌人消灭目标的人。

sentences.en: And when I say the enemy, I do not mean simply the enemy of my people.
sentences.zh: 当我说敌人时，我并不仅仅指我的人民的敌人。

sentences.en: I believe the enemy of one people is the enemy of all people.
sentences.zh: 我相信一个民族的敌人就是全体人民的敌人。

sentences.en: I believe that whatever happens to one community affects all communities.
sentences.zh: 我相信，一个社区发生的任何事情都会影响所有社区。

sentences.en: That is, (everyone applauding) that is why the tragedy of so many children today
sentences.zh: 就是，（大家鼓掌）所以才有了今天这么多孩子的悲剧

sentences.en: moves me so often through frustration and anger.
sentences.zh: 我经常因沮丧和愤怒而感动。

sentences.en: Every minute we spend together, now, my young friends, now somewhere on this planet, a child dies of starvation, disease and violence.
sentences.zh: 我年轻的朋友们，我们在一起度过的每一分钟，在这个星球的某个地方，都有一个孩子死于饥饿、疾病和暴力。

sentences.en: Are we doing enough to save them? Yes, as a Jew, I have learned to view my Jewishness as a fusion between the particular and the universal.
sentences.zh: 我们为拯救他们所做的努力是否足够？是的，作为一名犹太人，我已经学会将我的犹太身份视为特殊与普遍之间的融合。

sentences.en: I have learned to respect those who are not Jewish for what they are and not for what or they are not.
sentences.zh: 我学会了尊重那些非犹太人，因为他们是犹太人，而不是因为他们不是犹太人。

sentences.en: As a Jew, I have learned that even when the Messiah will come, and I believe that as a Jew, that one day redemption must come to humanity, even then the world will not become entirely Jewish.
sentences.zh: 作为一名犹太人，我了解到，即使弥赛亚到来，我也相信，作为一名犹太人，有一天救赎一定会降临到人类身上，即便如此，世界也不会完全变成犹太人。

sentences.en: It'll be boring. (everyone laughing) But it'll be simply more hospitable, caring, and friendlier.
sentences.zh: 会很无聊。 （大家都笑了）但它会更加热情好客、更加关心、更加友好。

sentences.en: I have learned, my young friends, I have learned, I have learned that learning is a passion that must not diminish with years.
sentences.zh: 我已经学会了，我的年轻朋友们，我已经学会了，我已经学会了学习是一种激情，绝不能随着岁月的流逝而减弱。

sentences.en: That applies to memory as well. It needs to be shared lest it remains stifled, icy, silent.
sentences.zh: 这也适用于记忆。它需要被分享，以免它保持窒息、冰冷、沉默。

sentences.en: Memory tells us that past is in the present, even when it is not unraveled.
sentences.zh: 记忆告诉我们，过去就在现在，即使它还没有被解开。

sentences.en: Memory has its own archeology, its own mystery, its own language.
sentences.zh: 记忆有它自己的考古学、它自己的神秘、它自己的语言。

sentences.en: If not complacent or intimidated, it'll enrich your respirations and commitments.
sentences.zh: 如果不是自满或害怕，它会丰富你的呼吸和承诺。

sentences.en: What would culture, education, or indeed civilization be without its lasting and challenging appeal.
sentences.zh: 如果没有持久和具有挑战性的吸引力，文化、教育甚至文明将会是什么样子。

sentences.en: My memory, though, rooted in the darkness of the abyss, has taught me the imperative of solidarity and friendship.
sentences.zh: 然而,我的记忆植根于深渊的黑暗之中,使我认识到团结和友谊的必要性。

sentences.en: My good friends, when I came place to those places and in those places, people told us then, "Don't think about anyone but yourself.
sentences.zh: 我的好朋友们,当我来到那些地方和那些地方时, 人们告诉我们,“除了你自己,别想任何人。

sentences.en: That is how you will survive." And they were wrong.
sentences.zh: 这就是你如何生存。" 他们错了。

sentences.en: Only those who thought of others, anyone who had a friend or a father or a brother, or simply a comrade for whom he or she cares, he or she had a better chance to live
sentences.zh: 只有那些想到别人的人, 任何人谁有朋友, 父亲或兄弟, 或仅仅是一个同志 他(或她)关心的, 他(或她)有更好的生活机会

sentences.en: and therefore to survive. My memory had taught me that my humanity is defined by yours.
sentences.zh: 我的记忆告诉我 我的人性是由你决定的

sentences.en: Even when my fate is different from yours, it is neither superior nor inferior in its authenticity.
sentences.zh: 即使我的命运与你不同 其真实性也不高低

sentences.en: Is its name tolerance? No. Tolerance could suggest condescendence.
sentences.zh: 不 容忍可以暗示为高尚

sentences.en: And I prefer the word respect, which also means respect for your freedom and mine, and for the freedom of those who have no freedom.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢尊重这个词, 也意味着尊重你的自由和我的自由, 尊重那些没有自由的人的自由。

sentences.en: I am free not because someone is not, but because he or she is.
sentences.zh: 我自由并不是因为某人不是,而是因为他或她就是。

sentences.en: And if their freedom is curtailed, mine is blemished.
sentences.zh: 如果他们的自由被限制, 我的就惨了.

sentences.en: And that is also true of hope, the most vital element of all human equations.
sentences.zh: 也是对希望来说, 也是所有人类方程式中最重要的元素。

sentences.en: War is an act of despair. Peace is a song of and for hope.
sentences.zh: 战争是绝望的行为,和平是希望的歌声。

sentences.en: And my fervent desire has always been to create a hope that is not someone else's nightmare.
sentences.zh: 我热切地渴望创造希望 而不是别人的噩梦

sentences.en: Now we have entered just now a new century.
sentences.zh: 现在我们刚刚进入了一个新的世纪。

sentences.en: It is still young and so is its hope. But what about its fears? What about its demons?
sentences.zh: 它仍然年轻,希望也依然渺茫。它的恐惧是怎样的?它的恶魔是怎样的?

sentences.en: They are old and so present. Hatred. Religious hatred is still ravaging the human heart in so many places.
sentences.zh: 宗教仇恨仍在如此之多的地方摧残人类的心。

sentences.en: Bosnia and Rwanda, all but forgotten, but Somalia and Sudan are not, must not.
sentences.zh: 波斯尼亚和卢旺达,除了被遗忘之外,索马里和苏丹决不能被遗忘。

sentences.en: In former refugee camps in Yugoslavia, I visited families in the tents, going around from one to the other, from one surviving victim to another
sentences.zh: 在南斯拉夫的前难民营里,我访问了帐篷里的家庭,从一个到另一个,从一个幸存的受害者到另一个。

sentences.en: listening to their tales. And not one of them succeeded in completing a story.
sentences.zh: 听他们的故事 但没有一个人成功完成一个故事

sentences.en: They all broke out in tears. And I felt perhaps this is what we must learn to collect tears and turn them into stories,
sentences.zh: 他们都流泪了,我觉得我们该学着收集泪水 把他们变成故事

sentences.en: into gestures of solidarity and compassion.
sentences.zh: 成为团结和同情的姿态。

sentences.en: From my teachers, I also learned the sublime art of questioning.
sentences.zh: 我从老师那里也学到了质询的高雅艺术

sentences.en: From Erasmus, I learned to praise folly, and from Montaigne to accept the power of doubt.
sentences.zh: 我从伊拉斯穆斯学会了赞美愚昧 蒙泰尼学会了接受怀疑的力量

sentences.en: I like nature's warning that madness is a consequence, not of uncertainty, but of certainties.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢大自然的警告 疯狂不是不确定的结果 而是确定性的结果

sentences.en: And this we better remember now for that exists a new or renewed scorch name fanaticism that afflicts contemporary events.
sentences.zh: 我们现在最好记住这一点,因为现在存在着一种新的或新的焦名狂热主义,它影响着当代的事件。

sentences.en: In my lifetime, it has already produced collective humiliations and mass murder, political fanaticism in Moscow, and racist fanaticism in Berlin.
sentences.zh: 在我的一生中,它已经造成了集体羞辱和大规模谋杀、莫斯科的政治狂热以及柏林的种族主义狂热。

sentences.en: Both were defeated, one politically and the other militarily.
sentences.zh: 双方都被打败,其中一人在政治上被击败,另一人在军事上被击败。

sentences.en: But the 21st century is already threatened by a resurrected religious fanaticism of the Middle Ages.
sentences.zh: 但21世纪已经受到中世纪复活的宗教狂热主义的威胁。

sentences.en: It grows in every religion, even in mine.
sentences.zh: 它在每一个宗教中,甚至在我的宗教中都有增长。

sentences.en: And some of its protectionists on the other part, on the other side.
sentences.zh: 和它的一些保护主义 在另一边,在另一边。

sentences.en: Some call themselves Martys, forgetting that both in Judaism and Christianity, a Marty is someone who dies for God, not someone who kills for God.
sentences.zh: 有些人自称马蒂斯 忘记了在犹太教和基督教里 马蒂是上帝的死神 而不是为上帝而杀人的人

sentences.en: So how is one- (everyone applauding) So how is one to fight fanaticism?
sentences.zh: 那么,如何是一个 - (大家鼓掌) 那么,如何一个打击狂热主义?

sentences.en: Whatever the answer, education must be its principle component.
sentences.zh: 无论答案如何,教育必须成为其主要组成部分。

sentences.en: In conclusion, only this. My young friends, this century is not mine, it is yours.
sentences.zh: 我的年轻朋友,这个世纪不是我的,是你的。

sentences.en: If there is hope and there must be, you'll shape it and you will justify it.
sentences.zh: 如果有希望,一定有, 你会塑造它,你会证明它合理。

sentences.en: All I can do is offer you my memories and experiences to help you in your quest so that the years ahead will enable you to confront the inevitable fear and trembling,
sentences.zh: 我所能做的就是给你我的记忆和经历 帮助你追求未来 让你能够面对不可避免的恐惧和颤抖

sentences.en: which are inherent to the human condition in its fight for better times.
sentences.zh: 这是人类为争取更美好时代而战所固有的。

sentences.en: Granted, the world you inherited is far from being safe and peaceful, but it is your task and maybe mine still to improve it.
sentences.zh: 诚然,你继承的世界远非安全与和平,但改善它还是你的任务,也许也是我的任务。

sentences.en: Remember, one person's courageous humanist initiative or moral commitment can make a difference.
sentences.zh: 记住,一个人勇敢的人文主义倡议或道德承诺能够带来变化。

sentences.en: And it has always. One person safe, one person or one family in those dark times, and they remain my idols.
sentences.zh: 总是这样。在黑暗时期,一个人安全,一个人或一个家庭, 他们仍然是我的偶像。

sentences.en: But even then, those who did so distort the honor of the human race and of humanity.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此,那些这样做的人也歪曲了人类和人类的荣誉。

sentences.en: Well, of all Albert Camus sayings, I prefer the one which comes to the denouement of his novel, "The Plague," "When everything is done,"
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯特·卡穆斯说,我更喜欢写他的小说《瘟疫》,《一切完成后》

sentences.en: "After all is said and done," said Camus, "there is more in man," which means in the human being, "to celebrate than to denigrate."
sentences.zh: Camus说,“在言行一致之后,人中还有更多的人,” 意思是“庆祝而不是诋毁。”

sentences.en: And so today, my young friends, let's celebrate our new beginnings.
sentences.zh: 所以今天,我的年轻朋友们, 让我们庆祝我们的新开端。

sentences.en: Let's celebrate man's power to transcend tragedy and his or her dream to overcome the oppressor's will to conquer and dominate.
sentences.zh: 让我们庆祝人类超越悲剧的力量 以及克服压迫者的征服和统治意志的梦想

sentences.en: Whether you know it or not, in some parts of the planet, there are people who need you and they are waiting for you.
sentences.zh: 不管你知不知道 在地球上的某个地方 有需要你的人在等着你

sentences.en: Thank you. (everyone applauding)
sentences.zh: 谢谢 (大家鼓掌)
